plugins.name: make-better
plugins.description: Continuously audit and improve an existing codebase. One command (/make-better) discovers subsystems and reviews stale ones across bugs, DRY, architecture, consistency, efficiency, tests, docs, and security. Plus /meta-review for retrospective audits of your own Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: feature
plugins.description: Build each feature/fix in an isolated git-worktree workspace: unique port, pretty *.localhost URL, detached dev servers, PR-per-iteration, and a live admin dashboard. Config-driven via .claude/feature/config.json.
